Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance

At Tether, weâre not just building products, weâre pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businessesâfrom exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMsâto seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.

Innovate with Tether

Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the worldâs most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.

But thatâs just the beginning:

Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.

Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.

Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

  • Engineering - Run the app and feature teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping.- Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs.- Own the technical design of features and the API surface between our AI core and the app.- Make sure your teams work closely with our AI research and deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches models or inference.

  • Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.



Mandatory:

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

  • Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels.Â We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:Â https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiterâs identity.Â All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If youâre unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods.Â We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses.Â All communication from us will come from emails ending inÂ @tether.to orÂ @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details.Â If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Job Title: Director, Payment Integrity

Reports To: Vice President, Operations

This is an exempt position reporting to the Vice President, Operations. The Director of Payment Integrity is responsible for the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams. This role functions as both the director setting strategy for these departments and the direct supervisor managing day to day operations. This position interfaces with all departments of SIHO as well as external stakeholders, vendors, and customers. The ability to interact with all levels of SIHO staff and external parties with a high level of professionalism, while adapting quickly between multiple high priority items, is essential.

Brief Description of Duties:

  • Directly supervise and manage the Quality Assurance, Grievances & Appeals, and Fraud, Waste & Abuse teams, including day to day oversight, staffing, and performance management
  • Read, research, and interpret federal and state regulations governing grievances and appeals, and translate regulatory requirements into practical, actionable process changes
  • Continuously monitor and improve grievances and appeals processes to ensure ongoing compliance with CMS and state regulatory requirements
  • Support the claims and benefit configuration quality assurance program, including developing and delivering training and education for staff
  • Stay current on emerging fraud, waste, and abuse trends and lead efforts to proactively identify and investigate potential FWA
  • Review results across all three departments and identify process improvement initiatives and cost savings opportunities
  • Analyze department and operational data in Excel to identify trends and draw actionable insights
  • Manage data transfers with vendor partners, meet with vendors regularly to ensure processes are working as intended, and escalate potential issues as they arise
  • Interact directly with customers as needed
  • Work with SIHO Legal and key leadership on special cases and external inquiries from CMS, the Indiana Department of Insurance, law enforcement, and others
  • Develop, maintain, and report statistical measurements assessing the effectiveness of the QA, FWA, and G&A programs
  • Lead or support key corporate and departmental compliance initiatives, including SOC audits, CMS Part C Reporting and ODAG, and others as assigned

Minimum Skills Requirement:

  • B.S. degree or equivalent work experience in a healthcare operation
  • 3-5 years experience in a managed care environment
  • Strong understanding of federal and state regulations related to grievances and appeals, including CMS and state Department of Insurance requirements
  • Experience across Medicare Advantage, ACA, employer group/TPA, and MEWA products preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage people and teams, while also directly supervising staff on a daily basis
  • Proficient in Excel with the ability to analyze data and draw actionable insights
  • Thorough understanding of medical and health plan terminology; familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, and ICD-10 coding a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate with all levels of management as well as external entities, vendors, and customers
  • Ability to work successfully at a self-directed pace in a changing, fast-paced, high demand environment, adapting quickly between competing high priority items
  • Ability to work successfully under tight deadlines
  • Experience with SIHO systems including the HSP claims system
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office suite products including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook

All positions are subject to change based on the needs of the business.

jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it.   • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Since then, Chaos has continued to grow with the additions of Cylindo, AXYZ Design, and Evolve Lab, further expanding our expertise and solutions across architecture, design, e-commerce, and AI. Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. The University segment operates through direct, relationship-led sales to institutions, while the Student segment runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey, requiring close partnership with the Ecommerce team to optimise the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

  • Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager (m/w/d) – E-Commerce & Retention Marketing
jobs.description:
Unternehmen: Invisible Brands GmbH
Erfahrungslevel: Senior

Du betreust keine Accounts. Du entwickelst erfolgreiche Brands weiter.

Stell dir vor, du übernimmst die Verantwortung für eine ambitionierte E-Commerce-Brand.

Du analysierst ihre Zahlen, erkennst ungenutzte Umsatzpotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinem Team Strategien, die wirklich etwas bewegen.

Wenige Wochen später steigen die Umsätze, die Kundenbindung verbessert sich und du sitzt mit der Geschäftsführung am Tisch, um die nächsten Wachstumsziele zu definieren.

Und das Beste daran? Du hast diese Entwicklung maßgeblich mitgestaltet.

Genau so verstehen wir Key Account Management bei Invisible Brands.

Wir suchen keine reinen Projektverwalter, sondern Menschen, die strategisch denken, Verantwortung übernehmen und für ihre Kunden zu echten Wachstumspartnern werden.

Wer wir sind

Wir sind Invisible Brands, eine spezialisierte Agentur für E-Mail- und Retention-Marketing aus Paderborn.

Wir helfen ambitionierten E-Commerce-Brands dabei, durch strategisches E-Mail-, SMS- und WhatsApp-Marketing nachhaltig zu wachsen.

Dafür verbinden wir datengetriebene Strategien mit kreativem Storytelling, hochwertigem Design und technologischem Know-how.

Zu unseren Kunden zählen Brands wie Braineffect, Gillie, Fairment, Dermalogica, Bär Schuhe, Cusb Clothing, YoungFashionMind und Aylashes.

Unser internationales Team wächst weiter. Deshalb suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, unternehmerisch denken und gemeinsam mit uns die nächste Wachstumsphase gestalten möchten.

Deine Aufgaben – Strategie trifft Verantwortung

  • Key Account Management: Du verantwortest dein eigenes Kundenportfolio, bist zentraler Ansprechpartner auf Entscheiderebene und entwickelst langfristige, vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen.

  • Retention-Strategie: Du entwickelst individuelle E-Mail-, SMS- und WhatsApp-Strategien, um Umsatz, Wiederkaufraten und Customer Lifetime Value nachhaltig zu steigern.

  • Performance & Reporting: Du analysierst relevante KPIs, identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale und präsentierst konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen in regelmäßigen Strategie- und Performance-Calls.

  • Projekt- & Teamsteuerung: Du koordinierst unsere Copywriter, Designer und technischen Spezialisten und stellst sicher, dass Strategien effizient und qualitativ hochwertig umgesetzt werden.

  • Kampagnen & Automationen: Du verantwortest die strategische Planung von Kampagnen, automatisierten Flows, Produktlaunches und saisonalen Aktionen.

  • Kundenentwicklung & Retention: Du erkennst frühzeitig Herausforderungen und Abwanderungsrisiken, entwickelst proaktiv Lösungen und baust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen langfristig aus.

Das Besondere: Du bist nicht für das operative Tagesgeschäft verantwortlich. Dir steht ein spezialisiertes Umsetzungsteam zur Seite, sodass du dich auf Strategie, Kundenentwicklung und Performance konzentrieren kannst.

Dein Profil – Das bringst du mit

  • Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im E-Mail-Marketing, CRM, E-Commerce oder Account-Management gesammelt, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld.

  • Fachliche Expertise: Du verstehst Retention-Marketing, Customer Journeys, Segmentierung und Marketing-Automationen und kannst daraus wirkungsvolle Strategien entwickeln.

  • Technisches Verständnis: Du bist mit Klaviyo oder vergleichbaren CRM-Plattformen vertraut und verstehst die grundlegenden Zusammenhänge hinter erfolgreichen Set-ups.

  • Analytisches Denken: Du kannst E-Commerce-KPIs interpretieren, Potenziale erkennen und daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ableiten.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du trittst souverän auf, kannst komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich erklären und kommunizierst mit Geschäftsführern und Marketingverantwortlichen auf Augenhöhe.

  • Ownership: Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, denkst unternehmerisch und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Entscheidungen und Ergebnisse.

Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Shopify, Klaviyo CDP, A/B-Testing, Kundenbindungsstrategien oder der fachlichen Führung kleiner Teams.

Ein Studium oder eine bestimmte Ausbildung ist für uns nicht entscheidend. Uns interessiert, was du kannst und welche Verantwortung du übernehmen möchtest.

Was dich bei Invisible Brands erwartet

  • Modernes Office: Ein hochwertiges Arbeitsumfeld mitten in Paderborn.

  • Bekannte E-Commerce-Brands: Übernimm strategische Verantwortung für spannende Marken und anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte.

  • Eigenes Kundenportfolio: Du erhältst echte Entscheidungsfreiheit und gestaltest die Entwicklung deiner Accounts aktiv mit.

  • Spezialisiertes Umsetzungsteam: Copywriting, Design und technische Implementierung werden durch erfahrene Kollegen unterstützt.

  • Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Arbeite mit Experten aus E-Commerce, CRM und Retention-Marketing zusammen und entwickle deine strategischen Fähigkeiten weiter.

  • Flache Hierarchien: Direkte Kommunikation, kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum.

  • Fitnessstudio-Zuschuss: Wir unterstützen deinen sportlichen Ausgleich.

  • Monatlicher Sachbezug: Nach deiner Probezeit erhältst du eine Sachbezugskarte mit monatlich 50 € Guthaben.

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Möglichkeit auf Unternehmensanteile (ESOP) nach zwijähriger Firmenzugehörigkeit

  • Firmenwagen: Je nach Position und individueller Vereinbarung besteht die Möglichkeit auf einen Firmenwagen.

Unsere Kultur – Ownership statt Dienst nach Vorschrift

Wir glauben an datenbasierte Entscheidungen, unternehmerisches Denken und den Anspruch, jeden Tag besser zu werden.

Bei uns zählt nicht, wer am lautesten spricht, sondern wer Verantwortung übernimmt und Ergebnisse liefert.

Wir suchen Menschen, die Herausforderungen frühzeitig erkennen, Lösungen entwickeln und nicht darauf warten, dass ihnen jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt.

Menschen, die ihre Kunden verstehen, ihre Zahlen kennen und den Anspruch haben, gemeinsam mit ihrem Team außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Du musst nicht auf jede Frage sofort eine Antwort haben. Aber du solltest den Ehrgeiz besitzen, die beste Lösung zu finden.

Bereit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil und ein paar kurze Sätze darüber, warum du Teil von Invisible Brands werden möchtest.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Invisible Brands GmbH

We don't just send emails. We drive growth.

  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our People team at Mirakl, a global team of around 30 people covering the full employee lifecycle across all of our offices worldwide. Together, you'll be contributing to building an exceptional employee experience and shaping the future of how Mirakl grows, learns, and develops its talent.

  • Coordinate learning events — Organise Manager Days, hackathons, bootcamps, lunch & learns and show-and-tell sessions, owning logistics, invitations, materials and post-event follow-up from start to finish.
  • Track participation and feedback — Manage attendance, collect feedback and synthesise key learnings and improvement opportunities to continuously raise the bar on our learning programmes.

  • Create practical resources — Develop guides, FAQs, checklists and quick-reference materials that support learning adoption and make knowledge accessible across the organisation.
  • Support AI fluency initiatives — Gather and document AI use cases, design surveys and knowledge checks, and organise assessment data to help the People team make informed decisions.
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's level degree in HR, from a business school or university
  • Experience in HR or learning is a plus, but not a prerequisite. Hybrid profiles combining analytical skills and project management are welcome.
  • Comfortable organising events and facilitating sessions, in connection with the projects mentioned.
  • Availability for a 6-month internship starting in January 2027 is required.
Skills:
  • Rigorous and autonomous, with strong tracking and reporting capabilities
  • Genuine interest in AI
  • Appetite for project management, data analysis and cross-functional collaboration
  • Strong communication skills in French and English
 

4. Tools Used

  • Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Collaborative tools (e.g. Notion, Google Workspace, or equivalent)
 

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent (C2 level required)
  • English: Professional proficiency (B2 minimum, C1 preferred)
 

6. Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  1. Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month, based on your level of study.

  2. Perks & Benefits:

    • A workplace that supports well-being and balance: breakfasts, fitness and yoga classes, after-work events, game nights
    • Mentoring from senior technical experts and regular feedback to support your growth
    • Immersion in a collaborative, international team passionate about sharing knowledge
    • 2 remote work days per month
    • Access to Works Council discounts (tickets, etc.)
    • Gymlib pass for your well-being
    • Modern offices in the heart of Paris (near the Eiffel Tower)
    • Swile meal vouchers
    • Transportation covered (50% Navigo, bike, etc.)
 

7. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, followed by an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. Interview with our recruiter to discuss your profile and expectations
  3. Interview with your future manager
  4. Structured interview using the STAR method to ensure transparency and fairness
  5. Welcome to Mirakl! 🎉

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French.

jobs.description:
Im Rahmen des europäischen Projekts «Europäische Standardisierung CCS-Strecke» arbeiten gemeinsam mit führenden internationalen Bahnindustrieunternehmen wie Siemens, Hitachi, Alstom und CAF sowie europäischen Infrastrukturbetreibern wie DB, SNCF, RFI, ÖBB, Network Rail und ProRail an der Weiterentwicklung und Harmonisierung zukünftiger Bahnsysteme.

Das Projekt ist Teil des Europe’s Rail Joint Undertaking (ERJU) und umfasst den System Pillar sowie den Innovation Pillar. Ziel ist die Entwicklung europaweit einheitlicher Betriebsprozesse, Systemarchitekturen und technischer Spezifikationen für die zukünftigen ERTMS-Zielsysteme, insbesondere ETCS Level 2 und Automatic Train Operation (ATO GoA 1/2).

Die erarbeiteten Standards bilden die Grundlage für zukünftige europäische Betriebsvorschriften sowie für die Weiterentwicklung und Beschaffung von Sicherungsanlagen.

Zur Unterstützung der internationalen Projektarbeiten suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior Business Analyst / System Engineer im Bereich Control, Command and Signalling (CCS).

  • System Engineering: Erarbeitung und Weiterentwicklung von Systemdefinitionen, Systemarchitekturen und technischen Systemspezifikationen im sicherheitsrelevanten Bahnumfeld (CCS).

  • Spezifikationserstellung: Entwicklung und Abstimmung von System- und Schnittstellenspezifikationen unter Berücksichtigung der Gesamtarchitektur sowie zukünftiger Bahnprozesse.

  • Prozesskoordination: Verantwortung für die effiziente Umsetzung und kontinuierliche Optimierung der Arbeitsprozesse (Workstations) zur Erstellung der Systemspezifikationen.

  • Operative Projektunterstützung: Unterstützung bei der Organisation, Koordination und Umsetzung der internationalen Arbeitsorganisation.

  • Qualitätssicherung: Sicherstellung einer konsistenten, vollständigen und qualitativ hochwertigen Integration der Arbeitsergebnisse in die übergeordneten Systemspezifikationen.

  • Stakeholder-Management: Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung mit internationalen Industriepartnern, europäischen Infrastrukturbetreibern sowie internen und externen Fachspezialisten.

  • Standardisierung: Mitwirkung bei der Entwicklung europäisch harmonisierter Betriebsprozesse und technischer Standards für zukünftige ERTMS-Systeme.

  • Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (ETH, Universität oder Fachhochschule) in Informatik, Ingenieurwissenschaften oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Fachgebiet.

  • Umfassende Kenntnisse des Bahnsystems, insbesondere des Bahnbetriebs und der Zugsteuerung.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich internationale Standardisierung im Bahnumfeld.

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Erstellung von System- und Schnittstellenspezifikationen im europäischen Umfeld.

  • Erfahrung mit Application Lifecycle Management Tools, insbesondere Polarion.

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Inhalte verständlich und zielgruppengerecht zu vermitteln.

Why we do what we do

We see the world through the lens of our psyche — like looking through a window that casts the outside world in shades of gray or vibrant colors. Every day, each of us has the power to shift our perspective and experience reality in a new way. When people gain access to this insight, mental barriers transform into opportunities for personal growth, leading to a more fulfilling and happy life. And because happiness is contagious, society changes—one mind at a time.

You studied psychology. Now what?

You love psychology. You've spent years learning how people think, feel and change. But you don't see yourself in a therapy room every day, and the other doors everyone points you to don't feel quite right either.

There is another one. At Aepsy, you'll work with psychologists instead of patients: finding them, supporting them, growing a community together and helping them build a practice they love. Your psychology background isn't a nice-to-have here. It's the reason psychologists will trust you.

The role

As Community Manager Romandie, you own our community of French-speaking psychologists in Switzerland, as part of our Community & Operations team in Zurich alongside the leads for our German-, Italian- and English-speaking communities. You find and onboard psychologists, you are their first point of contact, help them with administrative and everyday questions, and look out for new opportunities so they can bloom. Together, we will shape the role around your strengths and passions. This is a starting position designed to grow fast, with real ownership from your first weeks.

Be their voice inside Aepsy

  • Bring psychologists' feedback into our product, processes and operations

  • Work closely with our marketing, product & design, sales and insurance partnerships teams

  • Help with client support, translations and content in French

  • Spot what's not working yet and come up with better ways to do it

Key things we are looking for

  • You enjoy reaching out to people, finding out authentically what the right path is for them. When something gets in their way, you don't just take it away, you want to make it better. This role needs both: the courage to reach out and the heart to take care.

  • You're structured and at the same time full of ideas you want to push for. You're proactive, see opportunities in challenges, and thrive in a team where everyone supports each other and grows for something bigger.

  • If you hear about Aepsy's mission, your heart should beat faster, and your hand should instinctively reach out — because you won't want to miss the opportunity to be part of it. We need people who are crazy enough to believe that their actions can change the world.

In a nutshell

  • Full-time position (100%) on-site in Zurich, with potential day trips to Romandie

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Psychology

  • Work experience or projects that demonstrates your dedication (customer-facing, sales, student association…)

  • Structured, proactive and independent, and a natural relationship builder

  • Native or bilingual proficiency in French (spoken & written)

  • Good English (spoken & written) to work and communicate with our team every day

Together with us

We are a vibrant team with diverse backgrounds and beliefs, and we genuinely love what we do. We love conversations about the big picture as much as the smallest details. We work hard to make the world a slightly better place.

At the same time, we are mothers, fathers, husbands and wives, wine lovers, stand-up comedians, musicians, dancers, yoga practitioners, and Zen monks who appreciate and enjoy life.

Ready to join?

Sleep on it, take another look at this job ad. Read it again, believe that you belong at Aepsy, take a deep breath, and send us a personal application letter. (Yes, we will read it carefully, so please don’t send us generic templates, ChatGPT building blocks, or anything similar—there are so many better things to do.) Include your resume, and we look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Data Platform Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

As Data Platform Manager you will own Destinus's company data platform. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week.

You will own its architecture: how OneLake and our lakehouses are structured, how data lands in them from the systems we run, and how it holds up as more of the business comes to depend on it. You will lead a small team of data engineers — setting direction, reviewing their work, growing them — and you will keep building yourself. You are also the person who makes our AI ambitions possible: the foundation behind our data agents and our Company Brain is yours to design and deliver.

At Destinus we are redefining the future of aerospace manufacturing, building advanced Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) across three European plants. The data you will work with is physical — parts, build progress, shortages, non-conformances — and the questions asked of it get harder each year as we grow. If you want a platform you can still shape rather than one already set in concrete, this is a good moment to arrive.

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of our Microsoft Fabric estate end to end — OneLake, our lakehouses and their bronze, silver, and gold layers, workspace and domain structure, naming conventions, and the standards that keep it coherent as it grows.
  • Lead, mentor, and grow a small team of data engineers: set priorities, review code, raise the technical bar, and develop the people.
  • Stay hands-on. You will build pipelines, notebooks, and Delta tables yourself, not only direct others who do.
  • Own the integrations that land data in OneLake from our source systems — ERP, HR, shopfloor, quality, and the business applications that come after them — choosing sensibly between Data Factory pipelines, dataflows, shortcuts, and mirroring for each source.
  • Own the gold layer and the semantic models built on it, so that Power BI reads from one governed source rather than from copies scattered around the business.
  • Work closely with our Business Operations & Data Specialists, who represent the business owners of each domain: turn their requirements into the right gold tables, agree definitions with them, and give them a platform they can query, validate, and explain to the business with confidence.
  • Own lineage across the estate: know what feeds what, be able to prove it to an auditor, and make dependencies visible rather than tribal knowledge.
  • Build the data foundation for our AI programme — the lakehouse structures, pipelines, and knowledge graph behind our Fabric data agents and our Company Brain — and deliver it to a standard that can be trusted with a real question.
  • Design and maintain the OneLake security and access model together with your team: workspace roles, access groups, and the controls that decide who sees what in the lake.
  • Keep the platform reliable, observable, and cost-aware: monitoring, alerting, recovery, and disciplined use of our Fabric capacity — including knowing what a runaway notebook costs us.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

Requirements

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5-8 years of data engineering experience, including real ownership of a lakehouse architecture rather than only delivering against someone else's.
  • Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience is strongly preferred — OneLake, lakehouses, Delta tables, the SQL analytics endpoint, Data Factory pipelines, Spark notebooks, and semantic models in Direct Lake mode. If your depth is in Azure Synapse, Databricks, or Data Lake Storage Gen2 and you have since moved onto Fabric in earnest, we will take that seriously.
  • Strong command of the medallion pattern and of Delta Lake in practice: partitioning, schema evolution, table maintenance, and why a gold table behaves the way it does.
  • Genuinely hands-on. Strong SQL, solid PySpark, and comfort building and orchestrating pipelines yourself. This is not a role that stops at diagrams.
  • Practical understanding of Fabric capacity: how workloads consume it, how to spot what is burning it, and how to keep the platform inside its envelope.
  • Experience leading engineers — formally, or as a technical lead who set direction and mentored others. A first step into people management is welcome if the technical leadership is already there.
  • Proven integration experience with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365 / MSD, as well as APIs, flat-file landings, and change data capture from operational databases.
  • Solid data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling and an understanding of how a semantic layer serves Power BI.
  • Working knowledge of lineage, data governance, and access control in a cloud platform; exposure to Microsoft Purview is a plus.
  • Interest or experience in the data foundations behind AI assistants — retrieval, knowledge graphs, and preparing data so that an agent can answer with it.
  • Aerospace or another regulated industry is an advantage; so is experience in a start-up or scale-up.
  • Fluent in English; additional European languages are a plus.

Who You Are

You are an architect who never stops building. You have strong opinions about how a platform should be structured, and you earn the right to them by being in the code. You would rather make a design decision explicit and documented than let it live in one person's head.

You care more about reliability than novelty. You know that the measure of a data platform is whether people trust the numbers that come out of it on a Monday morning, not how modern the stack looks on a slide. When something breaks, you want to know why it was possible, not just how to patch it.

You enjoy growing engineers, and you understand that leading a small team means doing the work alongside them. Above all, you want to build something durable — a foundation that holds while the company scales on top of it.

  • Research new behavioural features and detection algorithms, reading the literature, testing ideas and killing the ones that do not survive contact with real data

  • Take work from hypothesis to production, prototyping in notebooks then writing the production-grade Python and SQL that scales

  • Choose the simplest solution that holds, rule-based when that is enough and machine learning when it is warranted

jobs.title: Compliance & Security Lead
jobs.description:
About Trigger.dev

Trigger.dev is an open source platform used by developers to build production-grade AI agents. It's an SDK and the infrastructure to run agents reliably at scale, so teams can focus on the product instead of the plumbing.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users' code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. With the rise of AI, being able to offload async tasks reliably is a key part of any developer's toolkit: We're building the infrastructure to make that a reality.

About the position

We're looking for our first Compliance & Security Lead to own security compliance and data protection at Trigger.dev. You'll report to the founders, and work closely with engineering.

We already hold SOC 2 Type II, run our program through Oneleet, and publish a trust portal covering SOC 2, GDPR and HIPAA. Until now the founders and engineers have handled compliance alongside their day jobs. As we grow, customers send more security questionnaires, ask for more reports and negotiate more DPAs. Now we need somebody to own this, keep it running all year, and free our engineers to build.

You don’t need to be an engineer, but technical experience is a bonus. This role suits someone process-minded who likes making compliance practical, rather than just ticking boxes.

What you'll be doing

You'll do a variety of things including:

  • Running our SOC 2 and HIPAA programs: owning our SOC 2 audit, managing evidence collection in Oneleet and keeping us audit-ready all year

  • Using AI and automation to speed up compliance work, from drafting questionnaire answers to collecting evidence and reviewing policies

  • Completing security questionnaires and vendor assessments, sharing our reports and bridge letters, and keeping our trust portal current

  • Reviewing and negotiating DPAs with customers and suppliers, working with our lawyers, keeping our records of processing up to date and handling data subject requests under UK and EU GDPR

  • Writing and maintaining our security, privacy and data retention policies, and making sure retention periods are enforced

  • Reviewing new tools and sub-processors before we adopt them, and keeping our sub-processor list current

  • Deciding when we need new frameworks, such as ISO 27001 or ISO 42001 (the AI management standard), and leading the work to get there

  • Making compliance seamless for the team: onboarding training, simple processes and automated evidence collection wherever possible

  • Keeping our incident response and breach notification process ready, and testing it each year

Requirements

You really need to have:

  • 5+ years in security compliance, GRC or data protection, ideally at a SaaS or developer tools company

  • Experience at an early-stage startup as the first or only compliance hire, with full ownership

  • Hands-on experience running a SOC 2 audit, from evidence collection through to the final report

  • An up to date working knowledge of UK and EU GDPR, and experience reviewing or negotiating DPAs

  • Experience completing security questionnaires accurately and quickly

  • Clear, plain writing - you can turn a policy into something engineers will read

  • Enough technical understanding to talk to engineers about cloud infrastructure, access control and logging (you don't need to write code)

  • If you are remote you must be within CET to ET timezones (GMT+1:00 to GMT-5:00). We will arrange 3 in-person events throughout the year

You'll be an amazing fit if you:

  • Have experience with ISO 27001 or HIPAA

  • Have used a compliance automation platform such as Oneleet, Vanta or Drata

  • Hold a privacy or security certification, such as CIPP/E, CISA or CISSP

  • Use AI tools to speed up questionnaires, evidence review and policy work

  • Are based in the UK and able to join the team in London

About the team

  • We are a small team with a flat hierarchy

  • We encourage continuous learning and personal development

  • Everyone operates autonomously; we trust you to get the job done, but to also quickly raise your hand if you need help

  • We care about our customers and the open-source community

  • Being a start-up, the work is challenging and fast-paced, but we also understand the importance of taking time off to recharge

Working at a Commercial Open Source Software company is more than just your day job

  • Our code is public, so anyone can see how we build and run our platform. We want our security and compliance to be just as open.

  • We publish our security reports and trust portal, so customers can check our work instead of taking our word for it.

  • Customers trust us with their code and data. We’re open about how we protect it.

Benefits

  • Generous compensation and equity - We hire the best talent and pay to reflect that. We also offer equity as a way to ensure everyone is invested in the success of the company.

  • Async working - Need a heads-down day or meeting-free days to stay productive? No problem!

  • Home office - We will help provide equipment for a comfortable setup so you're as productive at home as you are in the office.

  • Health insurance - Private health insurance, with Vitality for our UK team.

  • Dog and cat friendly office - Our London office welcomes four-legged colleagues.

  • Generous vacation - We believe it's important to take time off. We encourage you to take your 25 days vacation excluding national holidays, plus sick leave and generous parental leave.

  • Training budget - An annual budget to contribute towards learning such as purchasing books, an Audible subscription or online courses.

  • Pension contributions - Enroll in our company pension scheme or we'll contribute directly to your private pension.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Lead (Health Tech Start-up)
jobs.description:

EVERYMAN ist die führende digitale Gesundheitsplattform für Männer in der Schweiz, seit kurzem auch für Frauen (EVERYWOMAN), bald international

Rund CHF 200'000 Paid-Spend pro Monat. Ziel: verdreifachen in den nächsten 12 Monaten

Gemessen wirst du an CAC, Conversion und profitablem Wachstum, nicht an Aktivität

80-90k EUR plus Equity

Wir arbeiten AI-first, jeden Tag

Wir sind Everyman Health

Männer reden nicht gern über ihre Gesundheit. Solange es sie nicht gerade umbringt, ignorieren sie das Thema einfach. Genau darum haben wir Everyman Health gegründet. Wir bieten wissenschaftlich fundierte Behandlungen von A bis Z, für Männer jeden Alters. Diskret und so unkompliziert wie möglich. Schweizer Qualität 🇨🇭, zugänglich für alle.

Hinter Everyman steht ein erfahrenes Founder- und Produktteam mit Wurzeln bei Google, McKinsey, Stripe, Tidal, Oviva und Numan.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest die Performance unseres Funnels, von der ersten Ad bis zur bezahlten Conversion. Gemessen wirst du an Resultaten: CAC runter, Conversion rauf, profitables Wachstum. Du übernimmst komplette Kanäle in voller Eigenverantwortung, von Budget bis Creative. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of Marketing zusammen und hast wöchentliche Checkpoints mit dem C-Team. Die Wege sind kurz: Was du heute testest, ist morgen live.

Konkret heisst das:

  • Du setzt Paid-Kampagnen auf Meta, Google, YouTube und Native-Plattformen auf, inklusive Advertorials, und skalierst sie auf Effizienz
  • Du entwickelst Creative Briefs aus Kampagnendaten und Patienten-Insights und entscheidest, was die nächste Iteration bekommt
  • Du baust E-Mail-Kampagnen und CRM-Flows: Trigger, Segmente, Timing, alles datenbasiert
  • Du findest die Drop-offs im Funnel und fährst A/B-Tests auf Landing Pages, Quizzen und Checkout-Flows
  • Du automatisierst deine eigene Arbeit laufend mit AI. Was sich wiederholt, baust du weg
  • Du misst alles, erstellst Reports, die Entscheidungen auslösen, und entscheidest selbst, wo der grösste Hebel liegt

Was du mitbringst

  • Hands-on-Erfahrung mit mindestens zwei davon: Meta Ads, Google Ads, YouTube Ads, TikTok Ads. In mindestens einem Kanal bist du richtig tief drin, mit Resultaten, die das belegen
  • Erfahrung mit Advertorials und Native Ads

  • Nachweisbare Resultate aus strukturierten A/B-Tests und CRO, mit Zahlen, die du erklären kannst
  • AI ist dein Standard-Arbeitsmodus, nicht ein Tool unter vielen. Du automatisierst repetitive Arbeit und baust dir eigene Workflows für Creatives, Copy und Analyse

  • Du hast in deiner Laufbahn etwas gebaut oder erreicht, das klar heraussticht
  • Deutsch fliessend (unser Markt ist die Deutschschweiz), Englisch fliessend
  • Bonuspunkte: Erfahrung in Health, MedTech oder einem anderen regulierten Umfeld.

Kein SEO, kein Affiliate. Diese Kanäle spielen wir bewusst nicht.

Kein Kanal-Silo, aber auch kein Generalist ohne Tiefe. Du deckst den ganzen Growth-Stack ab und hast in mindestens einem Kanal einen echten Spike.

Kein Strategie-Job mit Slide-Produktion. Du setzt um, misst und iterierst.

Kein Ort für AI-Skeptiker.

Was wir bieten

  • 80-90k EUR plus Equity. Wenn das hier funktioniert, profitierst du direkt davon
  • Volle Ownership über deine Kanäle und Tests ab Tag eins, inklusive Budget
  • Ein Setup, in dem AI-Tools nicht diskutiert wird: du bekommst die Tools und das Budget, um deine Arbeit selbst zu automatisieren
  • Wöchentliche Checkpoints direkt mit dem C-Team, kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Remote (CET ±2h) oder hybrid in Zürich / Berlin
  • Creative- und Agentur-Support, damit du dich auf die Hebel konzentrierst, die zählen
  • Echter Impact auf die Gesundheit unserer Patient:innen

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung 🚀

jobs.title: Forschungsprojektleiter:in Energiedaten & Gebäudetechnik (d/w/m)
jobs.description:
termios macht Heizen in Wohn- und Gewerbeimmobilien smarter und klimafreundlicher. Unser Thermostat spart spürbar Energie und hilft Asset Managern, Wohnungsunternehmen und Eigentümern, ihre ESG- und Net-Zero-Ziele zu erreichen.

termios ist ein 2023 gegründetes Joint-Venture von mantro als Company Builder, dem sauerländischen Familienunternehmen Oventrop und der Düsseldorfer LEG Immobilien SE. Als Technologieunternehmen entwickeln wir grüne Lösungen rund um Heizen, Nachhaltigkeit und ESG für Wohnimmobilien.

Warum wir diese Stelle besetzen

Unser Thermostat termios Pro übernimmt den hydraulischen Abgleich automatisch, für jeden einzelnen Heizkörper, und ist in tausenden Wohnungen verbaut. Daraus entsteht ein Messdatenbestand zum realen Heizbetrieb im Gebäudebestand, wie ihn kaum ein einzelnes Forschungsprojekt aufbauen kann.

Wie viel Energie spart der automatische Abgleich wirklich, unter welchen Bedingungen, und wie weist man das sauber nach? Diese und ähnliche Fragestellungen wollen wir gemeinsam mit Hochschulen, Forschungsinstituten, Wohnungsunternehmen und Fördergebern beantworten.

Du startest dabei nicht bei null: Wir haben bereits zwei vom BMWE geförderte Forschungsprojekte und sind in weiteren Forschungsfeldern aktiv. Für dieses wachsende Portfolio suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt jemanden, der Forschung nicht nur organisiert, sondern selbst betreibt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Studiendesign und Feldversuche: Du übersetzt offene Fragen in prüfbare Hypothesen und ein belastbares Studiendesign mit Vergleichsgruppen, Baseline, Witterungsbereinigung und Messkonzept. Messkampagnen in realen Liegenschaften setzt du gemeinsam mit Field Service und Anlagentechnik um.

  • Datenanalyse: Du wertest Zeitreihen aus dem Gerätebestand und aus Messkampagnen selbst aus, quantifizierst Effekte und Unsicherheiten und trennst sauber zwischen Korrelation und Wirkung.

  • Ergebnisse: Du bereitest Erkenntnisse für Abschlussberichte, Fachpublikationen, Konferenzen und Kunden auf und sorgst dafür, dass sie in unsere Algorithmen und Produktentwicklung zurückfließen.

  • Projektleitung: Du steuerst mehrere parallel laufende Forschungs- und Pilotprojekte, von Arbeitspaketen und Meilensteinen über Budgets und Berichtspflichten bis zu Kooperationsverträgen, Datenschutz und Förderrichtlinien.

  • Förderung und Akquise: Du findest passende Förderprogramme auf Landes-, Bundes- und EU-Ebene, entwickelst Projektideen mit Partnern und schreibst Skizzen und Anträge.

Das bringst du mit

  • Studium: Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in einem ingenieur-, natur- oder datenwissenschaftlichen Fach, z. B. Gebäude- und Energietechnik, Versorgungstechnik, Bauphysik, Physik, Mathematik oder Informatik.

  • Forschungserfahrung: Du hast mehrere Jahre in der angewandten Forschung gearbeitet, etwa an einem Fraunhofer-Institut, einer anderen Forschungseinrichtung, einer Hochschule oder in einer F&E-Abteilung, idealerweise im Umfeld Gebäude, Energie oder TGA.

  • Methodik und Daten: Du hast Studien oder Messkampagnen selbst konzipiert und ausgewertet, wendest statistische Verfahren wie Regression, Zeitreihenanalyse und Hypothesentests sicher an und arbeitest dabei mit Python oder R sowie SQL.

  • Projektleitung: Du hast Projekte mit mehreren Partnern geleitet oder koordiniert und bringst unterschiedliche Interessen zusammen.

  • Kommunikation: Du schreibst klar und belastbar, vom Förderantrag bis zur Veröffentlichung. Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch auf Arbeitsniveau.

Das ist ein Plus

Niemand bringt alles mit. Vieles davon lernst du bei uns.

  • Förderprojekte: Du hast schon Anträge geschrieben oder öffentlich geförderte Projekte abgewickelt.

  • Heizungstechnik: Du kennst dich mit Heizungshydraulik, hydraulischem Abgleich und Wärmeerzeugern wie Fernwärme oder Wärmepumpe aus.

  • Einsparnachweise: Du kennst Verfahren zur Messung und Verifikation von Einsparungen, z. B. IPMVP.

  • Modelle: Du hast Erfahrung mit Gebäudesimulation (z. B. Modelica, TRNSYS) oder Machine Learning.

  • Promotion oder eigene Publikationen

Gute Gründe, um bei uns durchzustarten

  • Forschung, die ankommt: Wenn du eine Hypothese an einem realen Gebäude prüfen willst, organisieren wir das. Was du herausfindest, landet im Produkt, und Veröffentlichungen sind ausdrücklich erwünscht.

  • Alles unter einem Dach: Hardware, Firmware, Funk, Cloud und Daten. Wer das gebaut hat, wonach du fragst, sitzt im selben Team.

  • Flexibilität: Du arbeitest hybrid in Düsseldorf oder München, mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.

  • Konditionen: Unbefristete Festanstellung, wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung, 30 Tage Urlaub, Urban Sports und Corporate Benefits sowie regelmäßige Teamevents.

Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Lebenslauf, gern mit Publikationsliste oder Links zu deinen Projekten. Ein Anschreiben brauchen wir nicht. Schreib uns lieber ein paar Sätze dazu, welche Forschungsfrage dich bei uns besonders reizt.

jobs.title: Senior Privacy Counsel (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team.

Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers.

We're looking for a commercially minded privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, understanding how technology works and finding practical solutions to complex legal questions.

This is a broad, hands-on role combining privacy advisory work, commercial support and the continued development of internal data protection processes.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Advise colleagues across the business on a broad range of privacy and data protection matters, providing clear, commercially focused legal guidance.
  • Work closely with product, technology and commercial teams on the development of new services, ensuring privacy considerations are addressed early in the process.
  • Support the negotiation of commercial agreements, particularly around data processing, international transfers, customer relationships and third-party arrangements.
  • Advise on GDPR and other applicable international data protection regulations, helping the business understand and manage its obligations across different markets.
  • Provide legal guidance on emerging technologies, including AI, and the implications of new products and data processing activities from a privacy perspective.
  • Review and improve existing privacy policies, internal procedures and governance frameworks to ensure they remain practical and fit for purpose.
  • Work alongside information security and IT teams on data governance, risk assessments and privacy-related incidents.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency of privacy operations, including through automation and better internal processes.
  • Monitor regulatory developments affecting technology businesses, particularly around data protection, AI and digital services.
  • Provide training and guidance to colleagues across the organisation, helping non-legal teams understand their responsibilities when handling personal data.

What They're Looking For

  • A qualified lawyer with approximately 4-8 years experience specialising in data protection, privacy or technology law, gained in private practice, in-house or a combination of both.
  • Strong knowledge of GDPR and European data protection law, including regulatory guidance and its practical application within commercial organisations.
  • Experience advising technology businesses, ideally with exposure to software, AI, digital products or other data-intensive environments.
  • A good understanding of artificial intelligence technologies and the legal and regulatory challenges associated with their development and use.
  • Experience advising on commercial agreements involving personal data, international transfers and complex data processing arrangements.
  • Comfortable working directly with product, engineering and technical stakeholders, with the ability to understand complex issues and provide clear, practical legal advice.
  • A commercial approach to risk management, recognising that the role of legal is to help the business find workable solutions rather than simply identify problems.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities independently.
  • Experience working within an international business or advising on privacy matters across multiple jurisdictions would be beneficial.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

This is an opportunity to join an international technology business where privacy plays an important role in how the company operates, develops its products and works with customers.

You'll have a broad remit, working closely with different teams across the organisation on a range of commercial, operational and regulatory matters, including some of the challenges emerging technologies bring to data protection.

If you're a privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, has an interest in technology and takes a practical approach to solving legal challenges, we'd be interested in hearing from you.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Warum wir tun, was wir tun

Unsere Psyche ist das Fenster, durch das wir die Welt sehen – mal grau, mal hell. Wer lernt, dieses Fenster zu verstehen, kann jeden Tag eine neue Perspektive gewinnen. Aus psychischen Herausforderungen können Chancen zum Wachsen werden. Und weil Glück ansteckend ist, verändert sich so die Gesellschaft: one mind at a time.

Warum es diese Rolle braucht

Immer mehr Arbeitgebende und Versicherungen machen Aepsy für ihre Mitarbeitenden zugänglich – vom KMU bis zum Grossunternehmen. So erhalten mehr Menschen frühzeitig Zugang zu passender psychologischer Unterstützung.

Doch ein Angebot allein reicht nicht. Mitarbeitende müssen Aepsy kennen, verstehen und ihm vertrauen. Sie müssen wissen, wie sie das Angebot nutzen können, wenn sie Unterstützung brauchen.

Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen und sorgst dafür, dass aus Partnerschaften echte Wirkung entsteht. Dafür entwickelst du Aktivierungsmassnahmen, koordinierst Projekte und arbeitest eng mit HR-Verantwortlichen sowie unseren Teams aus Sales, Marketing, Operations und Product zusammen.

Was du bewegen wirst

  • Partnerschaften gestalten: Du betreust dein eigenes Portfolio an Partnerunternehmen, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und verstehst, was deine Ansprechpersonen bewegt.

  • Menschen erreichen und aktivieren: Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Aktivierungsmassnahmen, die Mitarbeitende auf Aepsy aufmerksam machen und zur Nutzung motivieren.

  • Projekte ins Rollen bringen: Du planst und koordinierst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, behältst Deadlines im Blick und bringst alle Beteiligten zusammen.

  • Wirkung sichtbar machen: Du analysierst Aktivierungs- und Nutzungszahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmassnahmen ab.

  • Dinge besser machen: Du hinterfragst Abläufe, bringst eigene Ideen ein und entwickelst unsere Partnerschaften, Prozesse und das Produkt weiter.

Was du mitbringst

Du musst nicht bereits alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, wie du denkst, wie du mit Menschen umgehst und was dich antreibt.

  • Erste Berufserfahrung in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, HR oder einem verwandten Bereich. Einen Hintergrund in Psychologie oder Gesundheitsförderung ist ein Plus aber kein Muss.

  • Freude am Aufbau von Beziehungen, Begeisterungsfähigkeit und ein ausgeprägtes Verantwortungsbewusstsein

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten den Überblick zu behalten

  • Analytisches Denken, Interesse an Zahlen und Freude daran, Prozesse zu hinterfragen und zu verbessern

  • Freude an einem dynamischen Umfeld, in dem nicht immer alles vorgegeben ist und Eigeninitiative gefragt ist

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

  • Bereitschaft, in einem 100-%-Pensum zu arbeiten und mehrheitlich vor Ort in unserem Büro im Herzen von Zürich tätig zu sein. Eine reine Remote-Tätigkeit ist nicht möglich.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt. Deine Arbeit hilft Menschen, psychologische Unterstützung zu finden, wenn sie sie brauchen. Du trägst dazu bei, mentale Gesundheit zugänglicher zu machen.

  • Ein Team, das dich stärkt. Du arbeitest eng mit Sales, Marketing, Product und unserer Psycholog:innen-Community zusammen. Unterschiedliche Perspektiven, viel Know-how und eine gemeinsame Mission prägen unseren Alltag.

  • Raum, Dinge zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns weiter. Deine Ideen sind willkommen, deine Verantwortung ist real und du kannst direkt mitgestalten, wie wir unsere Partner betreuen und Mitarbeitende erreichen.

Gemeinsam mit uns

Wir sind ein ambitioniertes Team mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Überzeugungen. Wir lieben Gespräche über das grosse Ganze genauso wie über die kleinen Details. Wir glauben an das, was wir tun, und arbeiten hart für eine etwas bessere Welt.

Gleichzeitig sind wir Mütter, Väter, Ehemänner und Ehefrauen, Weinliebhaber, Stand-up-Comedians, Musiker, Tänzer, Yoga-Begeisterte und Zen-Mönche, die das Leben schätzen und geniessen.

Bereit, etwas zu bewegen?

Schlaf darüber. Lies das Inserat nochmals. Und wenn du das Gefühl hast, dass du zu Aepsy passen könntest, freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein persönliches Bewerbungsschreiben. Erzähl uns, was dich antreibt, warum dir unsere Mission wichtig ist und weshalb dich genau diese Rolle anspricht. Wir lesen jedes Schreiben aufmerksam.

Das Unternehmen versteht sich als kompetenter Komplettanbieter und bietet seinen Kunden eine ganzheitliche Betreuung – von der individuellen Planung und Auslegung über die Fertigung und Lieferung bis hin zur fachgerechten Montage.

Dank der langjährigen Erfahrung, des umfassenden Know-hows und der internationalen Ausrichtung ist das Unternehmen weltweit tätig. Lieferung und Montage der modernen Lösungen erfolgen sowohl national als auch international.

Deine Chance: Eine vielseitige IT-Position mit Perspektive und Gestaltungsspielraum

Für diese spannende Position suchen wir einen engagierten und vielseitigen IT-Generalisten (m/w/d), der technisches Know-how mit Kommunikationsstärke, Eigeninitiative und einer positiven Grundeinstellung verbindet.

Du kennst dich mit der Konfiguration, Betreuung und Administration von IT-Systemen aus und hast Freude daran, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen, Lösungen zu entwickeln und pragmatisch umzusetzen.

Ein wichtiger Bestandteil deiner Aufgabe ist die enge Zusammenarbeit mit einem externen IT-Systemhaus. Dabei bist du nicht nur Ansprechpartner für technische Fragestellungen, sondern bringst dich aktiv in den Austausch ein: Du bewertest vorgeschlagene Lösungen, diskutierst technische Konzepte auf Augenhöhe und entscheidest gemeinsam mit den relevanten Ansprechpartnern, welche Maßnahmen sinnvoll und zielführend sind.

Qualifikation

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in der Betreuung, Konfiguration und Administration von IT-Systemen und IT-Infrastrukturen

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse mit ERP Systemen

  • Ein breites technisches Verständnis und Freude daran, dich in unterschiedliche IT-Themen einzuarbeiten

Die Möglichkeit, wirklich etwas zu bewegen!

jobs.title: GTM Financial Services Director
jobs.description:
GTM Director
We're looking for a commercially driven Go-To-Market leader to own how Treatwell takes its Financial Services products to market across Europe. Working closely with our sales teams and leaders, and with Product, you'll turn our roadmap into revenue, with a particular focus on growing our financial services product line. 

At Treatwell we don't just sell software: we help Europe's best salons and spas digitalise their business, grow their revenue and improve the experience they offer their clients.

You'll be the strategic owner of go-to-market for Treatwell across Europe. With a strong commercial mindset and a highly collaborative approach, you'll define how we position, price, package and launch our products, and partner with Sales to turn them into real, measurable revenue.

You will be responsible for:

  • Commercial go-to-market strategy: Own and lead Treatwell's European go-to-market strategy for its new suite of Financial Services products, defining target segments, positioning, pricing, packaging and commercial priorities, with a clear focus on revenue growth.
  • Financial services revenue: Own and lead projects that drive revenue for the financial services product line, from payments to new financial solutions, setting clear targets and taking accountability for results.
  • Sales partnership: Work closely with our sales teams and sales leaders across markets to shape commercial plans and targets, and turn go-to-market strategy into pipeline, deals and revenue.
  • Sales enablement & playbooks: Build scalable playbooks, pricing guidance, sales narratives and training that help local market teams sell our products and drive adoption on the ground.
  • Product launches: Partner with Product to bring new products and features to market, from validation and pilots through to full European rollout, bringing the commercial and customer perspective into the roadmap.
  • Product-led growth: Alongside our sales teams, build in-app and self-serve sales motions that help adoption and revenue scale efficiently.
  • Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Supply, Finance, Operations, Legal and local market teams to embed payments into acquisition, onboarding, account management and retention.
  • Strategy into execution: Translate strategy into clear execution plans with owners, timelines and KPIs, proactively removing blockers and driving accountability across teams that don't report directly into the role.
  • Commercial performance & optimisation: Track and drive adoption, revenue and margin across markets, using data and customer insight to optimise pricing, packaging and the sales funnel.
  • Stripe partnership: Manage Treatwell's strategic partnership with Stripe, acting as the senior commercial point of contact and aligning joint go-to-market plans and growth priorities.

About you

  • Proven experience in go-to-market, commercial strategy or sales strategy roles within a fast-growing digital or tech company (marketplaces, SaaS, delivery, fintech or similar)
  • Strong commercial focus, with a track record of owning revenue targets and driving measurable growth
  • Multi-market experience is a must: you've worked closely with sales teams and sales leadership across multiple markets

We're a team of 800+ people working every day to transform the beauty industry across Europe. We've built the leading salon management software, connected to Europe's number one marketplace, helping thousands of professionals run and grow their business.

The numbers speak for themselves:

  • Over 95,000 partner salons
  • Present in 14 countries
  • More than 23.5 million bookings every year

And the best is yet to come. If you want to join an international, innovative and fast-growing company where your work has a real, visible impact... join us!

We’ll treat you with:

💰Compensation: A competitive base salary and bonus package.

🌍Location & flexibility: Based in London, Milan or Amsterdam, working closely with teams across all our European markets.

💻Work tools: All the tools and technology you need to do your best work.

🚀Impact: A rare opportunity to build and own a new growth engine for Treatwell from the ground up.

Salary: €90K – €140K (depending on experience)

Equal opportunities

Onze missie is helder: beter eten voor meer mensen bereikbaar maken. Als Campaign Analyst in het Customer Retention team speel je hierin een cruciale rol door onze klanten beter vast te houden. Jij zorgt ervoor dat we al onze verhalen, over al onze producten, op de juiste manier aan de juiste klant vertellen. Je bent continu, datagedreven op zoek naar verbetering; zodat we het volgende verhaal nóg beter vertellen.

Wat je gaat doen

Onze retentiestrategie wordt steeds geavanceerder. We sturen niet simpelweg 'een korting' naar alle klanten maar werken met gelaagde acties, inspirerende verhalen en gepersonaliseerde extra’s.

Enerzijds ben jij de analytische drijfkracht achter de executie van onze campagnes. Je bouwt, beheert en verbetert de analytische tooling en dashboards zodat we kunnen blijven leren. Daarmee creëer je begrip van - en grip op - de commerciële impact van campagnes, en alle onderliggende onderdelen (zoals kanaalstrategie, product-samenstelling of klantdoelgroep). Vervolgens vertaal je de verworven inzichten effectief naar succesfactoren, verbeteringstrajecten en/of toekomstige experimenten. Anderzijds werk je inhoudelijk mee. Je bepaalt samen met de Campaign Specialist welk aanbod naar welke klanten gaat, via welk kanaal en met welke verwachting en zet je ook (nieuwe) acties zelf op.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.
