jobs.title: Senior Integration Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Integration Software Engineer to bring our algorithms and software backend together into reliable, operational solutions, and to take technical ownership of how our software is integrated.

Optics11 is a deep-tech company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing technologies for challenging environments and applications in energy and underwater security. Our systems enable high-performance sensing and monitoring through advanced photonics, signal processing, and data-driven intelligence.

We are expanding our R&D team with an Integration Software Engineer who enjoys building clean, reliable interfaces between components and working where software meets hardware, and who takes ownership of making complex systems work together end to end.

As a Senior Integration Software Engineer, you will support their integration into operational systems: connecting algorithms to the backend through robust APIs, building data connectors, health reporting and control software, and defining and verifying integrations with Command and Control (C2) systems.

You will work closely with domain experts in acoustics, signal processing and machine learning, and with the software engineering team, and hands-on with our monitoring systems at our headquarters and production facility. You will also take technical ownership of work delivered by internal and external engineers and set the standard for good engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead software integration engineering for our underwater acoustic sensing systems, ensuring frontend and backend components, algorithms, and hardware systems work together reliably.

  • Integrate the algorithmic toolbox with our system backends, turning research code into maintainable, versioned and deployable software components.

  • Implement data interfaces for our real-time sonar processing pipeline, to ingest multiple sensors (acoustic, heading, temperature, pressure, etc.) from internal and external data acquisition systems. Implement health reporting, logging and monitoring, so that the status and performance of software and system components is visible and actionable.

  • Develop the software control layer for our sensing systems and their hardware components, including APIs for commanding, state handling, error handling and recovery.

  • Implement, align and verify software integrations with external partners and C2 systems, being directly involved in defining interfaces, maintaining interface specifications and running joint integration tests.

  • Testing & debugging: Develop system-level test suites and CI/CD pipelines, diagnose communication failures, and ensure secure, reliable data transfers as the toolbox and backends evolve.

  • Address performance, latency and scalability of the integrated pipeline, together with algorithm and backend developers.

  • Work hands-on with integrated software and hardware systems at our headquarters and production facility, with occasional on-site visits.

  • Review the work of junior engineers and external development partners in depth, promote good practices for packaging, versioning and release, and share integration knowledge across the team.

Why Join Us?

  • Join one of Europe’s most promising deep-tech scale-ups.

  • Shape the future of a rapidly growing multidisciplinary R&D organization.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.

  • Enjoy regular team activities and company events.

  • Fresh team lunches provided 5 times/week.


Qualifications:

  • BSc or MSc in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field.

  • Significant professional experience in software engineering, with a focus on system integration, backend or platform development.

  • Extensive experience developing production software in Python, including packaging, testing, dependency management and writing maintainable, well-structured code.

  • Familiarity with systems programming in C++, or Rust, for the purpose of extending Python for more performance or hardware control.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and messaging interfaces (e.g. MQTT, WebSocket) and data serialization (e.g. protobuf).

  • Experience with realtime data pipelines, and handling high-throughput or streaming data.

  • Experience with Docker, CI/CD and automated testing in a Linux environment.

  • Experience working with software that interacts with physical systems, and comfort doing hands-on integration and troubleshooting in a lab or production environment.

  • Experience reviewing code and designs, mentoring junior engineers, and setting engineering standards.

  • An outcome-focused mindset, with the ability to own a problem end to end or break it down for others.

  • Ability to work with algorithm developers and translate research code into robust, maintainable software.

  • Flexible and proactive in taking on what needs to be addressed, and comfortable in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

  • Good communication skills in English and the ability to coordinate with internal teams and external partners.

  • Willingness to work primarily from our Amsterdam headquarters, as parts of the role involve classified information and physical systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Knowledge of defense systems or defense standards (e.g. NATO STANAGs, MIL-STD), for example in naval, maritime security or surveillance systems.

  • Experience with the scientific Python stack (e.g. NumPy, SciPy) or integrating signal processing or ML models into production systems.

  • Experience developing software interfaces for controlling instruments or devices.

  • Experience with other messaging or streaming frameworks (e.g. Kafka, ZeroMQ, DDS).

  • Familiarity with observability tooling.

Security & Compliance:

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please refer to details on security screening.

Was du bei uns bewegst

Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei:

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung moderner Server- und Cloud-Infrastrukturen auf Basis von Microsoft- und Azure-Technologien, die den Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen nachhaltig gerecht werden

  • Sicherstellung hoher Verfügbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit durch proaktives Monitoring, Wartung und kontinuierliche Optimierung bestehender Umgebungen

  • Schnelle und nachhaltige Lösung technischer Herausforderungen im Infrastruktur- und Serverumfeld zur Minimierung von Ausfallzeiten und Betriebsrisiken

  • Steuerung und Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten von der technischen Konzeption über die Realisierung bis zur vollständigen Dokumentation

  • Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Erfolg der teccle group durch die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Infrastrukturprojekten und die Sicherstellung einer hohen Kundenzufriedenheit

 

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du verfügst über fundierte Berufserfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft Server-Infrastrukturen in On-Premises- und hybriden Umgebungen

  • Du bringst Know-How in Cloud-Technologien mit - idealerweise in Microsoft Azure und Microsoft 365

  • Du gehst analytisch an Troubleshooting von Server- und Infrastruktur-Themen heran und findest nachhaltige Lösungen

  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team, identifizierst dich mit Server- und Cloudtechnologien und dokumentierst deine Arbeit strukturiert

  • Du freust dich auf persönliche Termine bei Kund:innen in der Region und hast idealerweise eine IT-Ausbildung sowie Microsoft Server- oder Azure-Zertifizierungen

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Nordrhein-Westfalen und bist berechtigt in Deutschland zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

 

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Bei uns bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickeln, wohlfühlen und mitgestalten kannst. Hier ein paar Gründe, warum du gerne bei uns arbeitest:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und bis zu 25 Tage arbeiten im EU-Ausland

  • Flexibilität, die zu deinem Leben passt: Nach erfolgreicher Einarbeitung (bis zu 6 Monate) kannst du 3 Tage pro Woche von zuhause arbeiten

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Zertifizierungen, individuelle Weiterbildungen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

  • Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander

  • Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Strukturen

Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind.
Unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Identität und Orientierung: Wir bieten allen Bewerbenden einen fairen Prozess und gerechte Chancen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten.

jobs.description:
This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social.

As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey!

Side quest: Read this new page about making new games at Supercell.

What You'll Be Doing

  • UX flow design for entire game experience

  • Creation and implementation of UI screens, assets and animations

  • Involved in pioneering a modern workflow and optimise assets for performance

  • Discover and manage external partners where needed

What You Have

  • 5+ years of experience shipping UI/UX design for apps/games

  • Portfolio showcasing end-to-end UI/UX work on game projects, with examples of UI and UX flows

  • Proven ability to translate game design requirements into intuitive and visually stunning UI solutions

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers, game designers and artists

  • Passionate about both UI & UX design

  • Range of 2D Art skills (UI elements, illustrations, animations, etc.)

  • Proficient understanding of Graphic Design and Typography

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

jobs.title: Head of Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
TLDR; Conduct's first revenue operations hire. You will build RevOps from scratch: the systems, planning and data our whole go-to-market team runs on, and make it AI-native from day one.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies compete by being different, and most of that difference lives in the software they've built for themselves, which decides everything from how parcels reach your door to how food gets onto supermarket shelves. That software is a real advantage, but it's also the hardest part of the business to change safely, so good ideas often wait months or even years for the systems to catch up.

Every large enterprise has a software company hiding inside it, and Conduct is building the operating system for it. We read a company's code and processes, work out what needs to change, and help the business and its systems move forward together, wherever custom software has become too complex to change safely.

Fortune Global 500 companies like DHL and Daimler Truck already trust us with their most critical systems, and we've just raised a $60M Series A from Index Ventures, ICONIQ and SAP.

We're a talent-dense team of about 70, growing fast across London and New York, with people from Palantir, G-Research, Legora and Sequoia. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here will shape the company and how the world's largest companies operate.

About the role

Our go-to-market team is growing fast in London and New York, and over the next year we'll scale it several times over, with new account executives and regional directors joining across both offices. They sell a technical product to CIOs and IT leaders at some of the world's largest companies, in long deals with many stakeholders, often alongside partners like SAP and the major consultancies. To grow at that pace, everyone needs one clear picture of the business and an operating rhythm they trust.

Today there's no RevOps function, so you'll be starting from a blank page. You'll decide how we plan, measure and run go-to-market, then build it yourself: the CRM and the systems around it, the planning cycle, the forecast and the analytics that tell leadership where to focus.

We're an AI company, so we expect RevOps to be AI-native too. Agents should do the work that headcount does elsewhere, so a small team can have an outsized impact. You'll work closely with our founders, sales leaders, partnerships, marketing and finance.

What you'll do

  • Build the function from scratch. Hire and lead a small founding team, and set one set of definitions, KPIs and data standards across sales, marketing, partnerships and deployment strategy, so the whole company works from a single source of truth.

  • Own the GTM tech stack. Implement and run the CRM and the tools around it, with clean data captured at the source rather than fixed after the fact.

  • Put agents to work. Design and ship AI workflows for account research, enrichment, routing, pipeline hygiene and forecast inputs, and decide where a human stays in the loop and how the output is checked before anyone acts on it.

  • Run the planning cycle. Own territory and coverage design, capacity and headcount planning, quota setting and comp plan design for enterprise land-and-expand deals.

  • Run the revenue rhythm. Lead forecast calls, pipeline reviews and QBRs, build a forecast leadership can rely on, and deliver board-ready reporting with the story behind the numbers.

  • Set commercial guardrails. Work with our deal desk on pricing discipline, approvals and contracting workflows for complex enterprise and partner deals.

jobs.title: LNG Commodity Owner
jobs.description:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

LNG Commodity Owner, Sparta Commodities

Singapore, Geneva or London

 

LNG moves on netbacks, shipping and a handful of hubs that rarely agree with each other. Plenty of people write about that. We want the person who builds the system that connects all the pieces of the puzzle, and then puts it in front of traders and makes it sell.

Sparta is building the data platform that energy traders, analysts and commercial teams use to make faster, better decisions. We cover forward curves, price assessments, market intelligence and trade flows across the global energy complex. LNG is our next vertical, and we want an exceptional builder to lead it.

 

The role

 

This is a builder's seat. It isn't just an analyst position, a sales role or a thought-leadership seat. You will be leading the development of Sparta's LNG offering, from the first netback model to the AI analyst that puts together a forward view on LNG markets autonomously, working with our engineering, product, data and commercial teams. You will set the direction and stay hands-on: prototyping, testing and shipping with the team, not handing over a spec and waiting. Building on its own is not enough. The job is to build a product LNG desks will pay for, which means time with clients is as much a part of the role as time in the code.

 

We are looking for someone who knows LNG deeply: JKM, TTF and Henry Hub relationships, netbacks and delivered economics, shipping and regasification costs, cargo arbitrage between basins and contract structures. Your job is to turn that knowledge into products. Expect a good part of your week to be hands-on with AI coding tools: prototyping a pricing model in Python, standing up a data pipeline, creating market-leading knowledge graphs that an AI agent follows and testing its answers against desk judgement. The rest goes on working with engineers to harden, scale and ship what the team builds.

 

The role reports to our Head of Commodities.

 

What you'll do

 

Building products, data pipelines and AI agents (~55% of role)

  • Lead the design and build of Sparta's LNG product set: netbacks, arbitrage routes, delivered price curves and the analytical tools that sit on top of them

  • Build the LNG expert inside Leonidas with our AI engineers: the tools it calls, the domain rules it follows and the knowledge base behind them

  • Build automated products with the team: a daily LNG brief autonomously written by AI analyst, alerts on the curves and spreads that matter, and the quality checks that catch errors before clients see them

  • Build evaluation sets that test the AI against desk judgement, and keep them passing as the product changes

  • Build the data pipelines behind the vertical with data and engineering colleagues: price inputs, freight and regas assumptions, vessel and terminal data, route onboarding and automated data quality checks

  • Ship to production with engineering through our normal process (pull requests, code review, tests, CI), and hold the bar on scale, security and reliability

 

Owning the LNG vertical (~25% of role)

  • Own the LNG vertical end to end: what we build, how well it works and how it performs commercially

  • Set and sequence the LNG roadmap with product and technology, so clients get something useful early and more every few weeks

  • Write the rules: the LNG conventions, definitions and desk judgement that every Sparta product and agent follows

  • Lead the people working on LNG across product, engineering and data: set priorities, unblock them and raise the bar on quality

  • Be the person the business comes to for any LNG decision

 

Building a product clients pay for (~20% of role)

  • Lead discovery conversations and technical demos with LNG trading desks, analysts and commercial teams, and use what they tell you to decide what to build next

  • Work with sales and account management on the first LNG deals and on adding LNG to existing oil and freight accounts: you bring the market credibility and the product, sales runs the commercial process

  • Give sales a clear account of what the product does and why a desk would pay for it, so they can sell it without you in the room

  • Represent Sparta at industry events, conferences and client visits as the LNG expert

 

What we're looking for

 

Required

  • Deep LNG market expertise: strong working knowledge of global LNG pricing (JKM, TTF, Henry Hub and the relationships between them), netbacks and delivered economics, shipping and regasification costs, cargo arbitrage between basins and contract structures

  • A track record of building, not just specifying: tools, models, pipelines or products you built hands-on and that other people rely on

  • Strong Python and SQL, and comfort with the rest of a modern stack: APIs, databases, cloud services and version control

  • Heavy, daily use of AI coding tools to prototype and ship far faster than a traditional build cycle, and the judgement to spot where an LLM gets the market wrong

  • Ownership and drive: you scope the problem, pull in the right people, get it built and shipped, and fix it when it breaks, without waiting for a detailed spec

  • Credible in front of trading desks: able to run a discovery call and a technical demo, and to hear what a client will pay for and what they won't

  • Experience leading or working closely with engineers, and the technical credibility to set direction with them

  • Experience in a commodity-facing role within energy trading, data/analytics, financial services or a closely related field

  • Ability to turn market complexity into rules, tests and code that make an AI agent answer like a good desk analyst

 

Desirable

  • Experience building AI agents or LLM applications: tool calling, prompt design, retrieval and evaluation

  • Experience shipping work to production alongside an engineering team (code review, testing, CI/CD)

  • Familiarity with LNG data sources: price assessments, vessel tracking and shipping data, terminal and regasification data

  • Experience with pricing, data or analytics platforms in the energy space, or with building one from scratch

  • An existing network within the LNG trading community

 

What success looks like

 

In your first six months, you will have:

  • Led the build and launch of the first version of Sparta's LNG offering: netbacks, arbitrage routes and delivered price curves in clients' hands

  • Built, with the AI team, an LNG expert in Leonidas that answers the way a good desk analyst would, with an evaluation set that proves it

  • Launched at least one automated product, such as a daily brief or a set of alerts, that runs every day

  • Written the LNG rules every Sparta product and agent follows

  • Set up, with data and engineering, pipelines that run and check themselves, so the vertical scales without manual work

  • Put the product in front of LNG desks, helped sales land the first LNG clients, and fed what the market told you back into the roadmap

 

Is this you?

 

This role is for you if you'd rather build the tool than write the note about it, you like being hands-on, you make the people around you build faster too, and you measure what you've built by whether a desk will pay for it. It probably isn't for you if the part of the job you enjoy most is publishing your market view, or you'd rather hand over a spec than help build what's in it.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

Senior Indirect Tax Manager (all genders)

Your Role & Impact

As Senior Indirect Tax Manager in our Global Tax function, you are the go-to person for European VAT and a trusted sparring partner for our growing international business. You give pragmatic, business-minded advice on VAT, sales tax and GST across our markets. You also build the structures and processes behind it: VAT set-ups in SAP Public Cloud, well-documented indirect tax processes and smart automation using modern tools, including AI.

What you'll do

  • Lead & Advise: Drive our European VAT agenda, manage global sales tax/GST, and advise internal teams on cross-border trade, e-commerce, and marketplace taxation.

  • System & Process: Build and maintain VAT logic in SAP Public Cloud, translating complex tax requirements into actionable guidelines for daily accounting operations.

  • Risk & Compliance: Document tax processes to audit-ready standards, conduct local risk assessments (e.g., VAT, plastic taxes), and implement consistent tax frameworks across projects.

  • Business Partnering: Collaborate with Finance, Operations, E-commerce, and Supply Chain to embed VAT compliance across the value chain and proactively address commercial shifts.

  • Regulatory Monitoring: Track global regulatory changes (e.g., digital reporting, ViDA, platform rules) and ensure timely organizational compliance.

  • Filing & Reporting: Oversee and be capable of preparing the accurate and timely preparation, review, and filing of VAT returns, EC sales lists, Intrastat, and other statutory filings.

  • Digital Transformation: Drive the automation of tax workflows using Alteryx for data analytics and AI tools (Gemini, Claude) to boost efficiency and consistency.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Challenge advice from external tax consultants and translate their findings into plain English for non-tax colleagues.

  • Project Management: Own end-to-end tax projects—from scoping to execution—while independently aligning internal and external stakeholders.

  • Strategic Impact: Report to the Global Tax Lead, ensuring tax considerations are fully integrated into broader business strategies and decision-making.

What You Bring

  • Degree in Business, Tax, Law, or a related field with a strong focus on taxation.

  • Multiple years of in-house indirect tax experience within an international corporate environment.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in European VAT, including cross-border supplies, OSS/IOSS, import VAT, and e-commerce.

  • Proven ability to break down complex VAT regulations into clear, practical instructions for non-tax teams.

  • Solid experience configuring or working with tax logic in an ERP system.

  • Hands-on experience with (or a strong eagerness to leverage) AI tools and data analytics (e.g., Alteryx).

  • Highly analytical, structured, and result-driven, with a pragmatic approach to supporting a fast-growing business.

  • Proactive, adaptable, and interculturally aware, backed by excellent communication skills.

  • Business fluency in both written and spoken English and German.

  • Commitment to regular on-site collaboration at our Düsseldorf office.

Nice to have:

  • Background in a tax advisory firm.

  • Knowledge of non-EU sales tax/GST frameworks (e.g., UK, US, Canada, Australia).

  • Hands-on experience with SAP Public Cloud.

Why Join Us?

  • Global teamwork: We work together across departmental and national borders on our vision of bringing the Toniebox to every child's room in the world.

  • Come as you are: This applies not only to the dress code, but to everything else as well. Because you can only give your best when you feel truly comfortable.

  • Mobility: Choose the offer that best suits you – a Germany ticket for unlimited mobility, a monthly payment of fifty euros for an office parking space, a leased bicycle or a remote work allowance.

  • Protection: Benefit from subsidies for employee savings plans, company pension schemes and disability insurance.

  • Relaxation & Time Out: Enjoy 30 days of paid annual leave plus three additional days off, such as Carnival Monday, Christmas Eve, and New Year's Eve. After one year of employment, you can also take up to 10 "toniecation days" (unpaid leave).

  • Continuous professional development: Benefit from our internal and external training opportunities as well as an individual learning budget to continuously expand your knowledge.

  • Language learning and relaxation made easy: Improve your communication skills with the Babbel language learning app and find relaxation through our access to the Calm meditation app.

  • Discounts: Benefit from attractive discounts on our entire tonies range.

 

As part of our principles, we are committed to supporting inclusion and diversity at tonies. We actively celebrate our colleagues’ different abilities, ethnicities, faith and gender. Everyone is welcome and supported in their development at all stages in their journey with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Head of Growth // AI Music Video Platform
jobs.description:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work. Our next target is a $15M run rate.

We grew around 3x in the last year with a small team and a founder who ran most of growth himself. We now have specialists across content, creators, design, paid, SEO and growth engineering, and we need the person who leads them: someone who owns the numbers, sets the direction and still does the work.

As our Head of Growth, you'll work directly beside the founder. You'll own new top of funnel traffic, paying customers, and acquisition cost, decide where the team spends its time, approve what goes out, and personally work on whatever is the biggest bottleneck. You'll also build the rest of the marketing team.

Tasks

  • Own our growth numbers: top of funnel traffic, new paying customers, acquisition cost by channel

  • Set quarterly goals, run the weekly growth meeting, and make sure every person on the team owns one number

  • Work hands-on on the biggest bottleneck, from landing page tests and onboarding emails to paid campaigns and creator deals

  • Approve paid creatives and content, and raise the creative and messaging bar across the team

  • Come up with the big messaging ideas, test them across landing pages, ads, social and email, and keep what wins

  • Build AI workflows and automations that make the whole team faster

  • Lead and grow the marketing team, including hiring the next roles

  • Plan and run campaigns such as product launches and seasonal offers together with product

Requirements

  • You have owned growth numbers at a B2C or self-serve product, ideally a consumer subscription or creator tool, and can show what you changed in paying customers, conversion or acquisition cost

  • You are hands-on. You still build campaigns, tests and ads yourself, and you're happy doing it

  • You have deep expertise in at least one of SEO/GEO, performance marketing or social media growth, and a good working knowledge of the others

  • You have a strong eye for creative and messaging, and you know how to improve an ad based on its numbers

  • AI is fully part of how you work. You build your own automations, agents and bots, and can show us some

  • You are analytical and comfortable in tools like PostHog, SQL and ad managers

  • You have built something on your own, whether a company, a side project, music or a sport, and you bring that drive to work

  • You communicate clearly, challenge directly and take ownership without waiting for instructions

  • You are based in Berlin or ready to relocate, and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

  • You have led people before, and you make the people around you better

  • Experience with music, video, creator tools or AI products

  • You have built a growth function from scratch at a small company

  • You make music or video yourself

How we measure success

Within your first month, you understand our product, users and channels, own a weekly growth scorecard with clear baselines, and we have agreed on targets for the quarter. You're already running the first experiments on the biggest bottleneck.

Within 90 days, you run growth and content without the founder in the loop, messaging tests run every month with clear winners, the numbers are moving, and you're hiring the next person on the team.

Within a year, marketing runs as a team with clear owners and goals, new paying customers are growing steadily against our targets, and growth no longer depends on the founder.

Benefits

VSOPs and profit sharing, bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning and development support, productivity tools, a headphone allowance, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus.

Neural Frames is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives, and are committed to building an inclusive and supportive workplace.

jobs.description:
Your Mission:

As a Senior Mechanical Systems Test Engineer (all genders), you will be responsible for the development, implementation, and operation of the Flight Control System (FCS) test environment (“Iron Bird”) at VÆRIDION.

You will lead a major engineering project with significant cost and program impact, ensuring the successful development of a fully integrated test rig that enables system integration, validation, and certification of the aircraft’s primary and secondary flight control system.

You will work at the interface of mechanical systems, actuation, control, and system integration, contributing directly to the development and certification of electric aircraft.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Test Strategy & System Responsibility

    • Take ownership of the test concept and strategy for the Flight Control System (FCS).

    • Define test requirements, architectures, and validation approaches for system-level testing.

    • Ensure alignment of all test activities with development, safety of flight, and certification objectives.

  • Iron Bird Development (Test Rig Project Leadership)

    • Lead the development, implementation, and commissioning of the FCS Iron Bird test rig.

    • Define system architecture, interfaces, and functional requirements of the test environment.

    • Manage the development of mechanical, electrical, and control system integration within the test rig.

    • Drive supplier selection, coordination, and technical oversight for test rig development (CAPEX project).

    • Ensure delivery of the test rig within program timelines, budget, and technical requirements.

  • Test Execution & System Validation

    • Plan and execute system-level test campaigns on the Iron Bird.

    • Ensure reliable, high-quality test data generation and reporting.

    • Analyse system behaviour and support validation of flight control performance and safety.

    • Support verification and certification activities.

  • Test Asset Ownership

    • Own the Iron Bird test asset, ensuring configuration control, readiness, and safe operation.

    • Establish processes for operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the test rig.

    • Ensure traceability and reproducibility of test configurations and results.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Work closely with flight controls, systems engineering, structures, and test teams.

    • Interface with design engineers to ensure testability and integration readiness.

    • Support integration of hardware, actuators, sensors, and control systems.

  • Health, Safety & Compliance

    • Promote and uphold a strong safety culture in all test activities.

    • Ensure compliance with relevant safety standards, especially for complex mechanical systems.

    • Establish risk assessments, safe operating procedures, and training for test operations.

 

Your Profile:

  • Degree in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, or a related field.

  • Extensive experience in testing and validation of complex mechanical or aerospace systems.

  • Proven experience in developing test rigs or large-scale test environments.

  • Experience in leading technical projects with high complexity and impact.

  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, actuation, and mechanical flight control architectures.

  • Experience in system integration testing, ideally in aerospace applications.

  • Experience with development of test rigs, Iron Birds, or similar system-level test environments.

  • Knowledge of instrumentation, measurement systems, and data acquisition.

  • Understanding of certification-driven testing and validation processes.

  • Experience managing suppliers and external partners for engineering projects.

  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive complex projects to completion.

  • Excellent problem-solving and system-level thinking skills.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.

Act as a strategic partner to the VP of UK & EEA, participating in regional leadership meetings to proactively identify productivity bottlenecks before they impact revenue.

  • Promote our CMS and LMS platform best practices (experience with any Learning and Content Management system is appreciated)

  • Maintain content libraries and repositories

  • Manage internal communication campaigns via email, Slack, and similar tools.

  • Manage data from training and other initiatives (including the analysis of data to identify and report on outcomes and gaps)

  • Supporting high-impact flagship events like Kick Off, President’s Club, and Commercial Leadership Summits

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of relevant experience in Sales/Commercial roles and/or Enablement/Training in FinTech, or Financial Services, or Tech, or SaaS

  • AI native, Tech-savvy and data-driven

  • Passionate about training and development

  • Experience creating video, digital marketing content, and social media content is a plus

  • Experience with Salesforce (reporting and dashboards) and Sales Engagement Tools like Clari, Groove, Salesloft, Outreach etc is a plus

  • Strong foundational knowledge of global payments (Acquiring, Issuing, Schemes, and alternative payment methods) is desired but not essential

  • Comfort and experience presenting to and influencing Director C-level stakeholders

  • Understanding of complex Business Revenue cycles

  • Great communication skills (copywriting experience is a plus)

  • Ability to prioritise and work well with others

  • Customer-focused and high attention to detail

  • Agility and adaptability in a dynamic environment

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

jobs.title: Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting
jobs.description:
Krijg jij energie van een financiële administratie die tot in de puntjes klopt? Heb je ruime ervaring met boekhouding en houd je graag overzicht over financiële processen? Jouw rol

Als Boekhoudkundig Medewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking van de financiële administratie. Je houdt je bezig met debiteuren, crediteuren, cashmanagement en grootboekcontroles. Daarnaast bereid je de maand- en jaarafsluiting voor en werk je nauw samen met de Financial Controller en andere collega's binnen Finance. Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van zeven collega's en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Patricia Pouw, Finance Manager.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn verder:

  • Debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer: Je beheert de openstaande posten, verwerkt ontvangsten en inkoopfacturen en onderhoudt contact met klanten en leveranciers over betalingen en factuurverschillen.

  • Cashmanagement: Je verwerkt bankmutaties, bewaakt de geldstromen en bereidt betalingen voor. Ook ondersteun je bij de liquiditeitsplanning.

  • Voorbereiden van de maand- en jaarafsluiting: Je zorgt dat de administratie volledig en tijdig is bijgewerkt. Je bereidt boekingen, reserveringen en balansspecificaties voor en ondersteunt bij de jaarafsluiting en accountantscontrole.

  • Grootboek en financiële controles: Je controleert grootboekrekeningen en financiële aansluitingen, onderzoekt afwijkingen en bereidt correcties voor.

  • Aanvullende administratie: Je houdt je bezig met intercompany-afstemmingen, vaste activa en de voorbereiding van btw-aangiften.

  • Procesverbetering: Je signaleert knelpunten, doet verbetervoorstellen en helpt de kwaliteit en efficiëntie van de financiële administratie verder te verbeteren.

Daarnaast ben je een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor collega's bij complexere boekhoudkundige vraagstukken en ondersteun je hen met jouw kennis en ervaring.

Ons aanbod

Een afwisselende functie bij Normec Foodcare, met ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, mee te denken en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je komt terecht in een betrokken team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Wat je verder mag verwachten:

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.000 en € 4.500 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring

  • Een dienstverband van bij voorkeur 40 uur per week. Een dienstverband van 32 uur per week is ook bespreekbaar

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding

  • De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan het fietsplan

  • Een continu ontwikkelprogramma waarin je wordt gestimuleerd om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen

  • Een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij VGZ

  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging die het hele jaar door diverse leuke activiteiten organiseert

Jouw profiel

Je bent een positief kritisch ingestelde en betrokken professional, die graag meedenkt en bouwt aan onze Finance-afdeling.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau in een financiële of boekhoudkundige richting

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring als Boekhouder, Financieel Administratief Medewerker of in een vergelijkbare financiële functie

  • Ruime ervaring met zelfstandig boekhouden, debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer en het voorbereiden van maandafsluitingen

  • Een goed begrip van grootboekadministratie, balansposten, btw en de samenhang tussen boekingen en financiële rapportages

  • Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

  • Een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde en proactieve werkwijze. Je voert niet alleen werkzaamheden uit, maar onderzoekt ook zelfstandig afwijkingen en denkt mee over oplossingen

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om prettig samen te werken met klanten, leveranciers en collega's. Je deelt graag je kennis en ondersteunt anderen waar nodig

  • Je bent bij voorkeur 40 uur per week beschikbaar

Over Normec

Normec Foodlab Ede is onderdeel van Normec, toonaangevend in de Testen, Inspectie, Certificering en Compliance (TICC) industrie. Onze expertise raakt essentiële gebieden zoals water-, lucht- en bodemkwaliteit, brandveiligheid en voedselveiligheid, waarbij we de hoogste normen van kwaliteit en veiligheid garanderen in verschillende sectoren. jobs.title: Stage: Optimalisatie Processen Industry
jobs.description:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdrachten

Tijdens deze stage binnen Nedlin Industry ga je aan de slag met een actueel vraagstuk uit onze dagelijkse operatie. Je onderzoekt waar verbeterkansen liggen, brengt processen en knelpunten in kaart en werkt jouw bevindingen uit tot concrete verbetervoorstellen.

Afhankelijk van jouw interesse kun je kiezen uit één van de volgende stageopdrachten:

  1. Klantcompleetheid verbeteren
    Onderzoek waar en waarom klantorders niet volledig worden geleverd, breng knelpunten binnen productie en expeditie in kaart en werk concrete verbeteringen.

  2. Transportkosten reduceren
    Analyseer transportkosten en routes, onderzoek de beladingsgraad en leverfrequenties en breng mogelijke kostenbesparingen in kaart.

  3. Doorlooptijden magazijn verbeteren
    Breng de magazijnprocessen in kaart, identificeer wachttijden en onnodige handelingen en werk verbeteringen uit om de doorlooptijd te verkorten.

  4. Gebruik van AI binnen de organisatie
    Onderzoek de mogelijkheden voor AI binnen de organisatie, bepaal kansrijke toepassingen voor de dagelijkse operatie en werk deze concreet uit.

  5. Werkinstructies vouwers en inpak verbeteren
    Beoordeel de huidige werkinstructies en onderzoek hoe deze eenvoudiger, duidelijker en visueler kunnen worden gemaakt voor medewerkers.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een hbo-opleiding of een mbo-4-opleiding en kunt aantoonbaar zelfstandig werken.

  • Je studeert bijvoorbeeld Technische Bedrijfskunde, Operations Management, Kwaliteitsmanagement, Human Factors, Communicatie of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je bent analytisch en oplettend, schrijft helder en kunt informatie eenvoudig en visueel overbrengen.

  • Je werkt zorgvuldig en zelfstandig en legt gemakkelijk contact met collega’s op de werkvloer.

  • Je zoekt een onderzoeks- en implementatiestage, waarbij gedeeltelijk meewerken in de praktijk mogelijk is..

Pak het moment

Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !

jobs.title: RF Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is making space simple. We build and operate reliable, shareable satellites that give customers a faster, simpler path to orbit. By combining flight-proven spacecraft platforms with our own hardware and software, we make it easier to deploy missions in space.

As an RF Systems Engineer, you'll contribute to the design, development, and integration of communication systems across our satellite connectivity and next-generation RF payload programs. You'll work on RF system architecture, signal processing algorithms, and performance analysis, collaborating closely with FPGA, embedded software, systems, and hardware engineers to develop and integrate complex RF technologies.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working at the intersection of RF hardware and signal processing, solving challenging technical problems, and seeing their work go from initial design to in-orbit operation.


About this Role:
  • Contribute to the design and development of RF systems for satellite connectivity and payload applications, including architecture, requirements, and technical trade-offs.
  • Perform RF link budget analysis and evaluate subsystem performance across S-band, X-band, and inter-satellite link (ISL) applications.
  • Develop and optimize signal processing algorithms for RF payloads using MATLAB and related simulation tools.
  • Support RF payload development across the signal chain, from antennas and RF frontends to ADCs and SDR systems, including signal detection and geolocation.
  • Collaborate with FPGA, embedded software, and systems teams to translate RF requirements into implementable solutions and integrate signal processing algorithms.
  • Define and track system requirements, documenting technical decisions, integration activities, and verification results.
  • Support RF testing, hardware integration, troubleshooting, and performance verification through AIT and in-orbit commissioning.
  • Work across engineering and AIT teams to drive successful development and integration of RF systems and payloads.

    • Must Haves:
  • 2+ years of experience in Radio Frequency (RF) systems engineering, subsystem integration, or a closely related field.
  • Proven experience with RF system integration, debugging, testing, and performance analysis.
  • Experience with signal processing algorithms, including the ability to model, analyze, or evaluate RF signal processing approaches.
  • Knowledge of RF communication systems and subsystems, particularly S-band and X-band communications.
  • Experience with RF link budget calculations and RF system-level performance analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with RF hardware, test equipment, and subsystem validation.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently drive technical activities and collaborate across system and software integration efforts.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.

    • Nice to Haves:
  • Experience with Software-Defined Radio (SDR) architectures and development.
  • Familiarity with FPGA-based signal processing, including experience working with FPGA teams to implement digital signal processing algorithms or IP blocks.
  • Knowledge of key SDR components and technologies, including channelizers, analog-to-digital converters (ADC), and digital-to-analog converters (DAC).
  • Experience using MATLAB for signal processing, modeling, simulation, or algorithm development.
  • Experience translating system-level RF and signal processing requirements into FPGA or embedded software implementation requirements.
  • Experience with antenna systems, RF frontends, and RF payload architecture.
  • Familiarity with RF geolocation, signal detection, spectrum analysis, or SIGINT-related applications.
  • Experience with RF testing, integration, and performance verification in an aerospace or satellite environment.

    • Some of Our Awesome Benefits:
  • Equity, we want you to have an active role in our success
  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)
  • Cross-office travel opportunities between San Francisco, Colorado, and Toulouse to learn from our differences
  • Company and team off-sites and many other events to work & celebrate together
  • Relocation assistance to Toulouse when applicable
    •  *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

    With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

    As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

jobs.title: Onboard Software Engineer - Peripheral Services
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the Hub’s onboard computers, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Peripheral Services team owns the software that integrates third-party devices and payloads into Loft’s standardized satellite platform. jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads on standardized satellites, giving our customers a fast, simple, and reliable path to orbit. Our AI for Space team is looking for a motivated intern to explore how fast, lightweight “System 1” models can boost reactivity, performance, and usability across our satellite operational chains.

Reactivity use cases are at the heart of Loft's vision, and we are scaling them: from single-satellite reactive loops, to two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue (a detection from one sensor automatically cueing an acquisition by another), and ultimately multi-satellite scenarios. Today we mostly rely on “System 2” models — powerful but slow and heavy at inference — from our partners. “System 1” models (fast, intuitive) are coming back strongly and could add value not only on reactivity, but also on performance and ease of use. This internship will assess that added value and prototype it on our reactivity scenarios.

Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station)
Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027.


About this role:
  • Review the state of the art on System 1 / fast, intuitive models and compare them with the System 2 models used today, including our partners' models.
  • Map where System 1 models could bring value in our operational chain for reactivity use cases, from detection to tasking.
  • Define benchmark scenarios of increasing complexity with the team: a single-satellite reactive loop, then a two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue loop, and, as a stretch goal, a multi-satellite scenario.
  • Set the latency budget, accuracy needs, and execution context for each scenario.
  • Build datasets and evaluation sets from Loft data, partner outputs, and open datasets.
  • Train or fine-tune System 1 models and benchmark them against System 2 baselines on reactivity (latency), performance (accuracy, compute footprint), and ease of use (integration and operational effort).
  • Prototype an end-to-end reactive loop, possibly as a hybrid design where System 1 triggers and System 2 validates, and assess how it extends to multi-satellite coordination.
  • Document results and recommendations for production use, and deliver a final demo.

Must Haves:
  • Final-year engineering or Master's student specialized in ML / deep learning / computer vision.
  • Solid Python and PyTorch skills, and good software engineering practices.
  • Strong understanding of the state of the art in LLM / VLM / Reinforcement Learning.
  • Practical experience training neural networks (language models or computer vision) and/or LLM manipulation.

Nice to Haves:
  • Model optimization (quantization, distillation, edge inference).
  • Exposure to satellite or geospatial data.
  • Multi-agent or distributed systems experience.
  • Genuine interest in space.

What Can We Offer?
You will join the AI for Space team and directly support the scaling of reactivity use cases, a core part of Loft's vision — working toward shorter detection-to-tasking latency on single-satellite and tip & cue scenarios, and a first step towards multi-satellite reactive operations. You'll build new expertise on an emerging class of models, reusable across other detection-like use cases, with a concrete prototype and benchmark the team can build on. With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, USA | Golden, USA | and Toulouse, France.

Some of our awesome internship benefits:
  • Gratification: €1,300 gross/month.
  • Lunch vouchers (tickets restaurant), because let's be honest, we love food! (we even have a Slack channel about it: #loft-gourmand)
  • Sustainable mobility package (forfait mobilité durable).
  • A genuinely international environment comprising 20+ different nationalities.
  • A genuine mentoring program to support you on a daily basis throughout the internship.
 *Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

Who We Are

Loft: Space Made Simple. 

Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Medisch Acceptatie
jobs.description:
Over ons

Europa verandert. Steeds meer mensen kiezen voor vrijheid — als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Ze bepalen zelf wanneer, hoe en met wie ze werken. Maar die vrijheid komt met een keerzijde: onzekerheid.

Bij Insify geloven we dat ondernemers zich geen zorgen moeten maken over verzekeringen. Daarom bouwen we iets wat de verzekeringswereld hard nodig heeft: transparante, eerlijke en volledig digitale verzekeringen, speciaal voor mensen die voor zichzelf werken. Geen ingewikkeld papierwerk, geen gedoe. Vandaag geregeld, morgen verzekerd.

We verzekeren inmiddels duizenden klanten in heel Europa — en we zijn nog maar net begonnen.


Het Operations Team

Wij zijn het gezicht van Insify. Bij elk telefoontje, elke e-mail en elk gesprek bouwen we vertrouwen op. We zorgen ervoor dat klanten zich gehoord, gesteund en goed geholpen voelen — ook als het ingewikkeld wordt. Snelheid en kwaliteit gaan bij ons hand in hand, en we verbeteren continu op basis van wat we leren. Met een groeiend medisch acceptatieteam en uitbreiding naar meerdere Europese landen, speel jij een directe rol in iets wat echt impact maakt.


Jouw rol

Als Medisch Acceptatie Werkstudent ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten in een van de meest persoonlijke momenten van hun ondernemerschap. Je werkt nauw samen met medische specialisten en zorgt ervoor dat aanvragen soepel, nauwkeurig en klantgericht verlopen. Dit is geen standaard bijbaan — je draait mee in een snel groeiend team waar jouw bijdrage echt telt.


Wat ga je doen
  • Klantcontact. Je beantwoordt vragen via telefoon, e-mail en chat. Je legt complexe verzekeringspolissen en medische beslissingen uit op een manier die klanten écht begrijpen.
  • Gegevensbeheer. Je vraagt medische dossiers op bij huisartsen en specialisten, controleert de volledigheid en verwerkt alles nauwkeurig in ons systeem.
  • Samenwerken met specialisten. Je fungeert als schakel tussen de klant en de medisch specialist — je vat informatie samen, signaleert complexe vraagstukken en houdt de communicatie helder.
  • Administratie. Je houdt klantgegevens up-to-date, verwerkt poliswijzigingen en bewaakt deadlines.

    • Wat je meebrengt
  • Je studeert momenteel, bij voorkeur in een richting met raakvlakken aan zorg, communicatie of bedrijfskunde.
  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 24 tot 32 uur per week.
  • Je Nederlands is uitstekend — zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Dit is een harde eis, omdat je dagelijks contact hebt met Nederlandstalige klanten.
  • Je bent georganiseerd, schakelt makkelijk tussen taken en verliest deadlines nooit uit het oog.

jobs.title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
jobs.description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

    • If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Senior Product Designer

Didomi is looking for a Senior Product Designer to take end-to-end ownership of design across multiple products within our Privacy and Consent Management Platform. This is a senior IC role reporting directly to the Design Director, acting as design peer-lead within the Product team, supporting our Product Managers and their engineering teams. Design is currently the one shared resource across the entire product org, and this role is central to how we scale it.

You'll help shape the future of our product, creating experiences that are intuitive, efficient, and user-centric, while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners. You'll get involved early, shaping problems alongside Product and Engineering rather than just executing against requirements handed to you, and take ownership of your workstreams once scope is assigned based on where the business needs it most.

What you'll do

  • Own the process end-to-end. Lead discovery through delivery for your assigned product areas, handing off finalized UX/functional design to our creative team for UI polish.
  • Shape decisions upstream. Get involved before requirements are locked, and bring evidence and clear rationale to engineering-first decisions rather than reacting after the fact.
  • Take ownership across ambiguity. Hold multiple complex workstreams and adapt as scope shifts with business priorities.
  • Build the research muscle. Help establish research and usability practices that don't fully exist today, and translate findings into decisions Product and Engineering can act on.
  • Reduce design debt. Flag and help prevent downstream friction from features shipping without a design pass.
  • Prototype fast with AI. Use tools like Figma Make or Claude to turn concepts into high-level, testable prototypes quickly, helping the team validate direction and unblock decisions without waiting on full design cycles for every idea.
  • Foster a strong design culture. Share knowledge, mentor peers, and help improve team processes.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in product/UX design, with real ownership of complex products and a strong portfolio of shipped work.
  • Fluency in Figma or equivalent design/prototyping tools.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving, engineering-heavy environments with limited day-to-day oversight.
  • Strong interaction and systems thinking. You can untangle complex flows and design for edge cases.
  • Experience building or contributing to a research practice where formal resourcing is limited.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work efficiently with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience designing zero-to-one products, new platforms, or defining new product spaces.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (Figma Make, Claude, or similar) to generate high-level prototypes and accelerate concept validation.

Strongly preferred: experience in privacy, compliance, or another highly regulated/technical domain.

We don't expect candidates to meet every point above. If most of this resonates, we'd love to hear from you.

Recruitment Process:

1. HR Screen (15 minutes)

2. Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes)

3. Live White boarding session (1h30) 

4. Peer interview with our Creative Lead

5. Final Interview with our CTO
